statement: Fixed sensor weighting is linear
meaning: Same finite weights and support; no physical response validation.

statement: Ideal linear maps preserve weights
meaning: The forward weighted-sum equation commutes with any fixed linear map.

statement: Shared affine maps preserve simplex mixtures
meaning: Sum-to-one or the exact offset-defect condition; same map on every component.

statement: Band reduction can destroy identifiability
meaning: The exact two-coordinate counterexample loses the A/B distinction.

statement: Every fewer-band library loses uniqueness
meaning: Whole-space noninjectivity does not imply failure on every restricted mixture simplex.

statement: A mixture spectrum lies in the reference convex hull
meaning: Nonnegative fractions total one; reference spectra use compatible coordinates.

statement: FCLS minimizer exists and is unique
meaning: Existence needs a nonempty finite simplex; uniqueness additionally needs identifiability.

statement: Known-parent ideal recovery works
meaning: True generating references, exact linear model, transformed identifiability, ideal solver.

statement: Good reconstruction guarantees true composition
meaning: Pure C and half A/B reconstruct the same spectrum with different class fractions.

statement: MESMA winner beats every physical mixture
meaning: The proved bound concerns admitted finite costs and a tolerance, not all biology.

statement: Positive-alpha ridge has unique fitted coefficients
meaning: Fixed centered design/targets and positive regularization; restore the intercept.

statement: One ridge prediction implies physical uniqueness
meaning: Perfect prediction can coexist with an ambiguous reference inverse.

statement: Ideal projection gives valid fractions
meaning: Nonnegative entries total one; feasible predictions are fixed and projection is idempotent.

statement: Projection cannot worsen distance to feasible truth
meaning: Euclidean projection and truth in the same nonempty simplex.

statement: Python exactly matches the spec for every input
meaning: Nine rational examples agree numerically; full IEEE/sorting/active-face equivalence is not proved.

statement: Representative Python calculations agree
meaning: Nine bridge cases plus four audit tests; declared per-case tolerances.

statement: Sampled category spectra differ
meaning: All ten pairs in the reported acquisition-matched design; not a Lean biological theorem.

statement: Ridge is universally better than MESMA
meaning: Matched15 removes the mean NEON advantage; domain and library capacity matter.

statement: Calibration and field observations are correct
meaning: Algebra does not supply independent sensor or label truth.

statement: Synthetic fractions establish field fractional cover
meaning: Independent contemporaneous field-fraction validation remains outstanding.
